content: Ananyas anà Safirà
Wɛɛ yàmɛnà naa mbuur mwɛy ikɔb ande Ananyas, ikɔb a un'kyay ande Safirà, ba bàyälà ywaŋ làmwɛy.
Ungö pa, un'tüüb mwɛy a un'kyay ande, nde kàyee yar a ngim làmwɛy, lumwɛy waa kàsyen, kàkàtɔl kà in'kɔl a Antööm.
Apan Petɔlà kàtɛn a nde naa: « Ananyas, ntɔn nkye Satanà uyööl nde mpem angye ntɔn ngye akür Dweelà Inkyɛɛl, waa ayee yar a ngim yan'fà u ngyäälà a ywaŋ?

Kusà ngye muyälà la, la kà làkäl làngye anki? Ungö ngye muyälà la, ngim ayin kà yàkäl kan'kɔɔ angye anki? Ntɔn nkye awel ngye an'kyän mukyer ndaa ayin? Ngye kà baar an'kur anki, wɛɛ ngye an'kur Nzam. »
Pa kàwɛm Ananyas ndaa ayi laa kàbü nde, waa kàkü. Baar banswà bàwem ndaa ayi, bɔɔmà làkyer akaar.
Apan atö laa bàmbarà ba, bun'läl ba ipfey, bun'syen ba u nsà, waa bun'dyee.
Yàmɛnà naa ungö a isii a an'taaŋ an'tär, un'kyay ande waa kàyàbilà, nde kàyöb anki ndaa yàlyaaŋ.
Petɔlà kun'fuul naa: « Nkyään, ngim làyälà bɛ ywaŋ abɛ, ayi? » Nde kàfuur naa: « Ɛɛ, ayi. »
Apan Petɔlà waa kàtɛn a nde naa: « Bɛ làtüüb aben an'kyän musi Dweelà a Mwol? Leer ntääm a baar bàkàdyee un'dim angye u munàmbwo, ba sye bàkyer asyen u nsà. »
Nde kàbü sye kusà a in'kɔl ande, waa kàkü. Atö bàyàbilà ba, bun'mɛn ba wàŋàkwà, waa bun'syen, bàkun'dyee tsütsü apà un'dim ande.
Apan, baar a ndwà a Nzam banswà bàmɛn bɔɔmà mbɔɔn anà baar bàwɛm ndaa ayi.
Impà a ifà ifà
Apan, u mbwo a an'kɔɔ a Antööm, idiim anà impà mbɔɔn byàkyer amɛnà uboo a un'sɛŋ a baar. Ba banswà sye bàkälà un'tüüb mwɛy uboo a un'lwaaŋ a an'ta a Salɔmun.
Wɛɛ akà mbuur asin wà nsà kàkwe anki mutüüb anà ba, wɛɛ un'sɛŋ kàkyer akanà mbɔɔn.
Lalan un'sɛŋ abaal anà akaar mbɔɔn bàsye làkwikilà amu Mwol, bàtüübà anà ba.
Ba sye bàtweyà baar an'kyal u mbwo, basyee udu a bitäb, taaŋ lumwɛy udu a bipɔy, ntɔn utaaŋ uyàlyaaŋ Petɔlà, munii ande ufwee itàkal umwɛy uboo a ba.
Un'sɛŋ a baar mbɔɔn bàfwee an'bul a tsütsü a Yɛlusàlɛm, bàtwäälà baar an'kyal anà baar bàkäl anà dweelà a làbe, ba banswà bàkyer akɔɔrà.
Antööm bàmamɛɛy nkwaaŋ
Apan, undweer a angaŋ anà baar banswà bàkäl anà nde, baar a un'tüüb a Asadusi, bàyöm mpem ntɔn Antööm,
waa bakör, basi u bɔlokà a baar banswà.
Wɛɛ uboboo a mpib, un'kyeey a Mwol kàduub ibeenà a bɔlokà, waa katwey anà mukàtɛn a ba naa:
« Làkyen, làmbär uboo a ndwà a Nzam, waa làkyään akà un'sɛŋ ndaa a mɔ̈ɔ̈ ayi yanswà. »

Ba bàkyer un'wem: ba bàkyen ututu tutu u ndwà a Nzam, waa bàsɛmà mulɔŋ. Undweer a angaŋ anà baar bàkäl anà nde bàbel baar a làbay a nsaŋ a kölàköl anà un'syääl a andweer a baan a Isàlɛl, waa bàtöm baar muwal Antööm u bɔlokà.
Wɛɛ utaaŋ ban'yà ba u bɔlokà, ba bamɛn anki. Ban'furà ba, ba bakyään
anà bàtɛn naa: « Bi bɔlokà ikàman làŋàdübà a kwab kwab, aseey bàkäl kà ikal aba kusà a munàmbwo. Wɛɛ umpal kan'duub bi, bi mbuur imɛn anki uboo. »
Mpal bàwɛm ba ndaa ayin, mfum a aleer a ndwà a Nzam anà amfum a angaŋ bàkäl kà ubem anà muyweer naa ndaa nà yàyeel antööm.
Wɛɛ mbuur mwɛy kayi mukasam naa: « Làler baar làbiil bɛ u bɔlokà, ba abanà uboo a ndwà a Nzam mukalɔɔŋà un'sɛŋ ndaa aba. »
Apan, mfum a aseey anà asyääl bàkàwal antööm a duu ntɔn ba bàmɛnà bɔɔmà naa manà baar balom in'kul.
Ungö batwääl ba, ba batɔ̈l u làbay a nsaŋ a kölàköl. Mfum a angaŋ kafuul naa:
« Nkye bi kàlatsüŋ anki mulɔŋ kà ikɔb aki? Wɛɛ bɛ, bɛ lan'yööl Yɛlusàlɛm anà an'lɔɔŋ abɛ, bɛ làkwen muwɔm an'kil a mbuur awà udu a bi! »
Petɔlà anà Antööm bumwɛy bafuur naa: « Yubwaŋ mulab Nzam wɛɛ kà baar anki.
Nzam a andweer abi kàwiiy Yɛsu akwà làdwä bɛ mpal lun'bɛɛrà bɛ u kulunsi.
Mbuur akwà kàsɛɛn Nzam u kɔɔ ande là ibaal asànaa nkum anà Un'tswää a mɔ̈ɔ̈ ntɔn mupà mbwo akà baar a Isàlɛl musɔɔmà anà muwal ndwääl a nkul a man'be aba.
Wɛɛ bi, bi ibà ambäl a ndaa ayi, bi anà Dweelà In'kyɛɛl kàpɛ Nzam akà baar bàfun'lab. »
Mpal bàwem ba ndaa ayin, un'fur a nkyɛl kàkyer awal, waa bàkwen mukadwa.
Wɛɛ kàkäl anà Umfarisi umwɛy uboo a ba, ikɔb ande Ngàmàlyɛl, un'lɔɔŋ a un'kɔɔn kàfakwenà un'sɛŋ wanswà, kàkyer ambarà, waa kàswɛŋ naa batwey ikikye antööm,
waa kàtɛn a ba naa: « Abaal a Isàlɛl, làkäl kà igyɛɛŋ ntɔn bɛ ŋakwo unsà undiir làkwen bɛ mukyer akà baar bà.

Lalan, itaan a mbɔɔn tɛy, mbuur mwɛy ikɔb ande Tɛwudas kàkyer ayàmɛnà, waa kàkyey uyɔl naa nde wà un'byääl. Isii a abaal nkam nà bàkyer un'lab. Wɛɛ nde bàkyer un'dwa, baar banswà bàkyer apay. Akà undiir kàfàkal anki.
Ungö a nde, utaaŋ musɔn ikɔb, mbuur mwɛy un'nsi Ngalilɛ kàkyer ayàmɛnà, ikɔb ande Yudas. Nde kàsyen un'sɛŋ a baar u mpey. Nde sye bàkyer un'dwa, baar bàkäl anà nde banswà bàkyer apay.
Wɛɛ apanà, mɛ in'tɛn a bɛ naa twon laläb, lawɛy ba bàkyen. Isàkal naa an'kyän anà isal aba byan'fà akà baar, bya ikyer ayàdiimà.
Wɛɛ, isàkal naa bya byan'fà akà Nzam, bɛ làkwe anki mudwa bya, naa tɛy, bɛ làyànwan sye a Nzam! » Ba bàsyääl an'kyän ande.
Abun, ba bàbel Antööm, bakäm an'füm, batsüŋ mutà ikɔb a Yɛsu din, waa bawɛy.
Apan sye, ba bàlwomà u làbay a nsaŋ a kölàköl unsà un'sak wanswà muman naa bàmatwey an'yɔl muman ntaan ntɔn ikɔb a Yɛsu.
Abun, ilä byanswà uboo a ndwà a Nzam anà uboo a ndwà a baar, ba bàwɛy anki mulɔŋ anà mupay Làsaŋ Aŋàbwaŋ là Klistɔ Yɛsu.
